    # the 4x4 arrangement. The demonstrated glyph encodes a 2x2 tile motif.

                elif c < 4:
                    out[r][c] = 4 if r < 2 else (2 if r >= 2 else 1)
                else:
                    out[r][c] = 4 if r < 2 else (1 if r >= 2 else 3)
    return out
